article.title: Epstein was strangled, forensic expert says after file review: BBC
article.author: Editor
article.content: Professor Michael Freeman tells BBC Newsnight that the New York medical examiner’s file points to homicide by strangulation, contradicting the official suicide ruling. The post Epstein was strangled, forensic expert says after file review: BBC appeared first on MR Online .
